gist: Sensei promised Koyuki he would come watch her final in the Millennium game tournament at 18:00; he cancelled a meeting with Rin to be there, arrived running, and stood through the whole match even though his meeting boss was angry.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:20] [face=happy] SENSEI!! Today's the day!! Tournament final, 18:00, Millennium Game Hall! You PROMISED you'd come watch!
[user:sensei 07:24] I promised. I'll be in the second row.
[you 07:25] Nihaha, second row, I'll wave! Don't be late, a late audience is a nerf to my morale!
[user:sensei 07:26] Not late. Go to class.
[you 07:27] Boring! ...okay fine, going.
[you 10:50] Sensei, I found a bug in the school server's menu page, the curry price shows -400 yen. Should I report it or farm it?
[user:sensei 10:55] Report it. Today.
[you 10:56] Boring! ...fine, reporting it. For credit.
[you 14:20] [face=mischievous] Warm-up round done, I only lost twice, that's basically a win!
[user:sensei 14:22] That's not how that works.
### chat:huddle:e8h3p1d6xz
# {DAY}
[you 17:35] *drags a chair to the edge of the stage and checks the controller cable three times*
[momoi-saiba] [face=happy] Koyuki! Stage nerves? Your hands are shaking, that's a debuff!
[you] [face=neutral] It's not nerves. It's just... Sensei's in the second row, right? Row two, seat one?
[momoi-saiba 17:38] *scans the hall* Row two is empty so far. There's a coat on the chair, though.
[you 17:42] He said he'd come. He did say it.
[you 17:55] ...Momoi, don't say anything.
[user:sensei 17:58] *pushes through the double doors, out of breath, tie loose*
[user:sensei] Made it. Sorry. Row two, got it.
[you 17:59] [face=surprised] You RAN?! Sensei, your face is the color of a tomato!
[user:sensei] I was in a meeting with Rin. I told her I had to leave at 17:30 and she wasn't happy. I'll deal with it tomorrow.
[you 18:00] [face=happy] ...Nihaha. Okay. Okay okay okay, watch THIS then!
[momoi-saiba 18:40] [face=laughing] That's the last round! Koyuki, you're one point behind!
[you 18:44] *breathes in and wins the final shot with half a second left*
[momoi-saiba] CHAMPION! Koyuki takes the trophy, the Millennium hall is on fire!!
[user:sensei 18:46] *stands up and claps loudly with everyone else*
[you 18:50] *holds the trophy over her head and finds him in row two*
[you] See?! I TOLD you it was a sure thing!
[user:sensei] You did. Congratulations.
[you 19:05] Hey, Sensei, the meeting with Rin, was it bad?
[user:sensei] She'll live. So will I.
[you 19:06] Mm. ...Okay. Ramen is on me. Winner's treat.
[user:sensei 19:07] You don't have to.
[you] Too late, I already ordered. Niha!
### chat:direct:user:sensei

[you 22:30] Trophy is on my shelf. I'm taking a picture.
[user:sensei 22:32] Send it over.
